title: Exploit Chain: IDOR + Mass Assignment Privilege Escalation
description: Step 1: Attacker (Customer A) uses IDOR in GET /api/v1/customers/:id (finding-007, CWE-639) to access Customer B's record. Step 2: Attacker uses mass assignment in PATCH /api/v1/customers/:id (finding-015, CWE-915) to escalate Customer B's role to ADMIN. Step 3: Customer B (now ADMIN) can access all admin endpoints including password hashes (finding-025,027, CWE-200). Step 4: Attacker logs in as Customer B with ADMIN privileges for persistent elevated access.
impact: Horizontal privilege escalation via IDOR to target victim, then vertical privilege escalation via mass assignment to ADMIN, resulting in persistent admin access and credential theft.
mitigation: 1) Add ownership verification in customer endpoints. 2) Remove role field from mass assignment in customer PATCH. 3) Remove password_hash from API responses.
